envs.name: CharacterGroup
envs.doc: the package provides an environment, CharacterGroup, taking, as mandatory argument the denomination common to each character belonging to the current group.

envs.name: drama
envs.doc: Two versions, of this environment, are provided: the normal version, used for typesetting dramas in prose, and the starred version (drama*) for typesetting dramas in verse.

envs.name: stagedir
envs.doc: The stagedir environment calls by default the quote environment, but can be redefined by the user to do everything by means of \StageDirConf.
